item.title: SA Open set for tight finish on Sunday as Casey Jarvis holds narrow advantage in Stellenbosch
item.description: This close! South African Casey Jarvis currently leads the field at the 115th SA Open in Stellenbosch and will look to put in another faultless display in the final round to capture his maiden SA crown.

item.title: Abdeslam Ouaddou reveals mental prep drove Orlando Pirates to Soweto derby success
item.description: Orlando Pirates reclaim the top spot after a historic 3-0 Soweto derby win. Coach Ouaddou credits &quot;positive narrative&quot; and video workshops for the Bucs' clinical performance at FNB Stadium. Photo: Itumeleng English Independent Media

item.title: High stakes at Loftus: Mamelodi Sundowns and Sekhukhune United lock horns in title-defining clash
item.description: MAMELODI Sundowns had to dig deep to beat AmaZulu 1-0 in their last league match as seen Teboho Mokoena and Nuno Santos challenging Athini Maqokolo of AmaZulu FC. On Sunday Sundowns face Sekhukhune United in the top-of the table battle at Loftus.

item.title: US, Israeli Aggression: A Turning Point for the Middle East
item.description: Firefighters attend to a blaze at the site of an Iranian missile strike in Tel Aviv on February 28. If the US and Israel succeed in eliminating Iran’s entire military-political establishment – a longtime ambition – there will be no safe corner in the Middle East, says the writer.
